integrity: Exact polynomial recurrence and analytic proof are stated in RESULT.md. A standalone Python checker gives 835 consistency assertions for the finite cases tested. The six scientific documentation files and code are self-contained.
scientific_limitations: The all-degree dichotomy is restricted to 0<gamma<1, exact inverse-age reset hazard, a fixed qubit phase gate, and full reset to its initial coherent state. Numerical root checks are finite, not a replacement for the positive-definite determinant proof. Unindexed prior beta-binomial zero-location literature is a residual priority risk. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: A sharp finite-time zero dichotomy for inverse-age quantum-reset coherence
